scripts.dev:all: nx run-many -t dev -p client site api
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres minio && docker compose run --rm minio-init
scripts.release:api: bun run db:migrate && bun run build:api
scripts.build:all: nx run-many -t build -p client site api
scripts.cap:add:android: bun run --cwd apps/client cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: bun run --cwd apps/client cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync:android: nx build client && bun run --cwd apps/client cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: nx build client && bun run --cwd apps/client cap sync ios
scripts.cap:copy:android: nx build client && bun run --cwd apps/client cap copy android
scripts.cap:open:android: bun run --cwd apps/client cap open android
